reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Mixing alcohol and pre-workout isn't a great idea - alcohol's a depressant, pre-workout's a stimulant, and together they can mess with your heart rate and hydration more than either alone. Best practice is don't stack them same day. If you're drinking socially, skip the pre-workout that day and just train on caffeine from coffee if you need something."}
